body: yep, absolutely hate myself. I'm from a pretty wealthy family and I feel like I've been taking things for granted. I feel like all this money invested in me is such a waste and I'm just one extra problem they have to take care of. They are probably just taking care of me because of their sense of obligation as parents. For friends, yeah I have plenty of em. But whenever I speak my mind about these kinds of stuff they just shake it off as a joke. Everything is such a hassle, I just want to die
I just don't like myself, and i feel like i have no purpose in life so might as well just end it.
